newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RTRS-ANZ joins move to raise NZ mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ joins move to raise NZ mortgage rates.

text.p: ANZ Bank and its associate Postbank said on Thursday they would raise their variable and fixed mortgage rates, with the variable rate rising to 10.4 percent from 8.95 percent as of August 11.

The group is the second big home lender to pass a recent leap in short-term money rates on to the bulk of its mainstream retail customers after Countrywide Bank on Wednesday raised its variable rate to 10.5 percent from 8.95 percent.
The sister banks, owned by the Australian and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, will also raise their one-, two- and three-year fixed rates for applications received after July 26.
